crossRefs.note: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even…
The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in…
to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Hormah
people.line: A Canaanite city captured by Judah and Simeon

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
translations.bsb: And the LORD heard Israel’s plea and delivered up the Canaanites. Israel devoted them and their cities to destruction; so they named the place Hormah.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
translations.asv: And Jehovah hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.
